Vs.
Most Halima Khatun and others ----- Respondents
full_judgment: 3. The pre-emptor in her application sated, inter alia, that she was the co-sharer in the case holding whereas the preemptees were strangers therein. The vender opposite party No.3(in the miscellaneous case) transferred the case land to the preemptees without serving any notice upon her; that the case land appertaining to S.A. Plot Nos.1492, 1491 and 1586 of S. A. Khatian Nos.1214, 89 and 1213 respectively was duly recorded in the names of Abdul Jalil and Madar Sheikh; that Jalal Sheikh, son of Abdul Jalil and the pre-emptor sold some land from those khatians to one Ukiluddin Sarder by registered deed and the vender purchased .06 acres land from him, but neither Ukiluddin nor the vendor had any possession in the case land; that the vendor was her son -in-law who collusively transferred the case land vide the impugned kabala bearing No.1160 dated 13.09.1993 to the pre-emptees, but they did not take possession of the case land till 21.04.1997, when they brought bricks and other construction materials in the case land whereby she came to know about the sale; that there was a local 'salish' on 22.05.1997 over the sale and on the denial of the pre-emptees to return the case land, the pre - emptor filed the case on 09.06.1997 after obtaining certified copy of the impugned kabala on 24.05.1997.
